initial_understanding: On the Arabic homepage she reads «القيمة الحقيقية لعقارك» above a description promising Erbil properties, market indicators and offers, so she files it as valuation plus listings for Erbil (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: The market page she needs for her Pirmam Road comparison is headed «نیشاندەرەکانی بازاڕ بەم زووانە» — a coming-soon notice rather than data (E-SITE-14).
trust_concern_observed: The provenance phrase «نوێترین سەرچاوەی پشکنراو» and named developers read well to a trusting broker (E-SITE-08); the raw heading 'map.investment' on /invest reads as unfinished (E-SITE-15).
frustration_point: Her trigger is a language she cannot read; Arabic project pages carry typos like «علي شلرع 120 متر» and canonicalise to Kurdish URLs, so she keeps switching (E-SITE-10, E-SITE-09).
most_useful_feature: Project facts such as Alaska Towers 1360 units / 8 towers / 23 floors with developer «لۆریەنت کۆنسترەکشن» give her something to check against her own notes (E-SITE-08).
missing_information: No price per square metre, no dated market figures, and the companies directory is «کۆمپانیاکانی خانووبەرە بەم زووانە», so she cannot see which agencies are on the platform (E-SITE-14).
what_would_change_decision: Publish the market indicators page with dated, sourced prices per area, starting with the corridors she works.
simulated_reaction: «أسماء المطوّرين موجودة، لكن صفحة مؤشرات السوق تقول قريباً؛ سأعود حين تظهر الأسعار.» (Developer names are there, but the market indicators page says coming soon; I will return when prices appear.)

initial_understanding: Reading Arabic as his second language, «القيمة الحقيقية لعقارك» suggests valuation while the description promises listings and indicators; with basic property knowledge he cannot tell which is the main offer (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: /ar/offers has an empty heading while /ar/offers/map is titled «عقارات للبيع والإيجار — Andaz», so he is unsure which page actually holds properties (E-SITE-07, E-SITE-20).
trust_concern_observed: Neutral by disposition, he notes /contact, /privacy and /terms all return '404 · Andaz' and no social profile exists, only info@andaz.app and info@mulkwallet.com (E-SITE-17, E-SITE-03).
frustration_point: His trigger, tiles stalling on a weak connection, was not measurable here; what the text shows is that no project description or JSON-LD carries a price, so costly data buys no figure (E-SITE-08, E-SITE-22).
most_useful_feature: GeoCoordinates on every project page and a dedicated price map page «نەخشەی نرخەکان», whose content was not observed (E-SITE-22, E-SITE-16).
missing_information: Any price or trend for Ankawa 2 versus Royal City; the trend comparison (T04) was not observable, and Royal City is not among the project slugs recorded (E-SITE-02).
what_would_change_decision: An indicative price range on each project page plus a text-only area price table that loads without map tiles.
simulated_reaction: «أفتح الصفحات على باقة بيانات محدودة ولا أجد سعراً واحداً؛ الإحداثيات جميلة لكنها لا تُظهر الاتجاه.» (I open pages on a limited data plan and find not one price; coordinates are nice but show no trend.)

initial_understanding: As an owner planning to sell first, «القيمة الحقيقية لعقارك» speaks to him directly; he takes the site to be a valuation service with Erbil listings attached (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: The Arabic area page for erbil-mahalla-022 is headed «کورانی نوی», a Kurdish name in an odd spelling rather than an Arabic one, so he guesses which neighbourhood it is (E-SITE-20).
trust_concern_observed: Nothing lowered trust for this trusting reader; developer names and statuses like «تەواوکراو یان ئامادە» matched the vocabulary he already uses (E-SITE-08).
frustration_point: His trigger, colour-only price cues, is not checkable in text; what is observable is an areas index with an empty H1 and generic title, poor for anyone enlarging text and navigating by headings (E-SITE-06).
most_useful_feature: 81 area pages named as residents say them, for example «شۆرش», and coordinates on every project page (E-SITE-23, E-SITE-22).
missing_information: Any figure for price direction; trend comparison (T04) was not observable, and Khabat does not appear among the area names recorded (E-SITE-23).
what_would_change_decision: Per-area price figures written as numbers and words on each area page, never as colour alone.
simulated_reaction: «الأحياء كلها هنا بأسمائها الحقيقية، لكن أين الأرقام؟ أريد أن أعرف إن كان البيع الآن مجدياً.» (All the neighbourhoods are here under their real names, but where are the numbers? I want to know whether selling now pays.)

initial_understanding: The hero «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت» sounds like a valuation tool, while the description promises Erbil properties and indicators; with no property background he cannot decide which it is (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: One project appears as «شاری ئیتاڵی 2», «شاری ئیتالی 2» and «ئیتالی ستی 2» on the same page, so he wonders whether it is one project or three (E-SITE-10).
trust_concern_observed: Tatweel-stretched names such as «داڤـــۆس ستی» and mixed Arabic/Kurdish letters read like copied developer posts, the same feel as the groups he already follows (E-SITE-22).
frustration_point: His trigger is missing prices: none of the 64 project descriptions or JSON-LD blocks contains a price, so the comparison with Telegram groups, which post prices, ends there (E-SITE-22, E-SITE-08).
most_useful_feature: The roughly 22 projects with long editorial text give more context than a group post does (E-SITE-22).
missing_information: A price or range per project, and which sources the phrase «نوێترین سەرچاوەی پشکنراو» refers to; page weight on his weak connection was not measured.
what_would_change_decision: An indicative price range, or an explicit 'price not published by developer' note, on every project page.
simulated_reaction: «لە گرووپەکانی تێلێگرام هەر پۆستێک نرخی لەگەڵە؛ لێرە پڕۆژە هەیە بەڵام نرخ نییە.» (In the Telegram groups every post comes with a price; here there are projects but no price.)

initial_understanding: His first-screen understanding was not observable (T01 cannot_assess); the only Arabic positioning text recorded is the description «اكتشف عقارات أربيل ومؤشرات السوق ومعروضات العقارات مع أنداز.» (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: Trying to change language he meets sign-in pages served in English at the Kurdish path, 'Welcome back' and 'Create your Andaz account', hard for a basic reader (E-SITE-12).
trust_concern_observed: Skeptical: /contact, /privacy and /terms are all '404 · Andaz', no social links exist and only info@ addresses were found (E-SITE-17, E-SITE-03); the phrase «نوێترین سەرچاوەی پشکنراو» is a small plus (E-SITE-08).
frustration_point: His trigger is a missing 'updated' date, and no published or modified date appears in any project metadata (E-SITE-08); rental listings near Gulan Park were not observable (T02).
most_useful_feature: None for this persona; the rental surface «عقارات للبيع والإيجار — Andaz» exists but its listings were not observed (E-SITE-20).
missing_information: Dates on anything, and actual asking rents near Gulan Park; the area page «گولان 2» carries only the generic site description (E-SITE-23).
what_would_change_decision: An 'updated on' date shown on every listing and project page.
simulated_reaction: «لا تاريخ تحديث ولا رقم هاتف؛ كيف أعرف أن الإعلان ليس قديماً؟» (No update date and no phone number; how do I know the listing is not old?)

initial_understanding: The English homepage pairs 'The true value of your property' with 'Explore Erbil real estate, market indicators and property offers with Andaz.', so she reads it as a place to browse offers (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: /en/offers is headed 'Properties for sale and rent' but /offers has no heading at all, so she cannot tell which page is the rentals list (E-SITE-18, E-SITE-07).
trust_concern_observed: No contact, privacy or terms page at the usual paths and no social profiles; only info@andaz.app and info@mulkwallet.com surfaced in a deep scan (E-SITE-17, E-SITE-03).
frustration_point: Needing to reach a lister this week, she finds 0 phone numbers on the homepage and every scanned page (E-SITE-01, E-SITE-08); an unexplained term like 'map.investment' is exactly her leave-trigger (E-SITE-15).
most_useful_feature: The advisor landing 'Let’s find your kind of place.' is reachable without login, though its answers were not observed (E-SITE-18).
missing_information: A call or WhatsApp route, rent levels near primary schools, and plain explanations of the site's terms; page weight on her unstable connection was not measured.
what_would_change_decision: A visible contact route with expected response time on every offer and project.
simulated_reaction: I found the page called 'Properties for sale and rent' but no number to call anyone, and on my data plan I cannot keep tapping around. (gloss: wants a phone number before spending more data)

initial_understanding: Through a screen reader the H1 «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت» and the bare title 'Andaz' announce valuation, not buying; only the description mentions offers (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: /invest announces itself as 'map.investment' in both title and heading, a raw translation key read aloud as the page name (E-SITE-15).
trust_concern_observed: As an engineer he reads /en and /ar project pages canonicalising to the Kurdish URL, and an address block on only a minority of pages, as unfinished data work (E-SITE-09, E-SITE-19).
frustration_point: His trigger is no contact route: 0 phone numbers on all 64 project pages and '404 · Andaz' at /contact (E-SITE-22, E-SITE-17).
most_useful_feature: schema.org Residence JSON-LD with GeoCoordinates on every project page, machine-readable text his tools can use (E-SITE-22); button labelling itself was not observed.
missing_information: Price, payment basis and any down-payment term; none appears in descriptions or structured data (E-SITE-08), so his 10 percent question has no answer.
what_would_change_decision: Price basis and payment plan text on each project page, plus a build check that fails on raw translation keys.
simulated_reaction: «ناونیشانی لاپەڕەکە ‹map.investment›ە؛ بۆ خوێنەرێکی شاشە هیچ مانایەکی نییە. نرخیش لە هیچ پڕۆژەیەک نییە.» (The page title is 'map.investment'; to a screen reader it means nothing. And no project has a price.)

initial_understanding: Without property background, «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت» sounds aimed at owners, not at someone curious about an area, and the description does not say who runs it (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: Trying English for easier reading, she finds /login showing 'Welcome back' in English at the Kurdish path while /en/login points its canonical back to /login (E-SITE-12, E-SITE-18).
trust_concern_observed: A skeptical remote visitor: /about and /contact return '404 · Andaz', og:site_name is just 'Andaz' and no operator name appears anywhere in metadata (E-SITE-18, E-SITE-01).
frustration_point: Her trigger is no legal identity; the About path is a 404 and the error page itself carries only '404' as heading (E-SITE-18, E-SITE-17).
missing_information: Who operates Andaz, an address and phone; area pages carry only the generic description, and Pirmam Road is not among the recorded area names (E-SITE-11, E-SITE-23).
what_would_change_decision: An About page with the operator's legal name, address and contact details linked from every page.
simulated_reaction: «کێ لە پشتی ئەم ماڵپەڕەوەیە؟ نە ناوی کۆمپانیا، نە ناونیشان؛ لە دوورەوە ناتوانم متمانە بکەم.» (Who is behind this site? No company name, no address; from abroad I cannot trust it.)

initial_understanding: The H1 promises valuation and the description promises discovery; for a renter the word «پێشنیارەکان» in the description is the only hint that rentals exist (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: /offers has an empty heading while /offers/map says «موڵک بۆ فرۆشتن و کرێ», so he cannot tell which page is meant for rental browsing (E-SITE-07).
trust_concern_observed: Skeptical, he notices «پرۆژە» and «پڕۆژە» both used and three spellings of one project, which read as careless editing (E-SITE-10); the English 'Welcome back' at sign-in adds a small break (E-SITE-12).
frustration_point: His trigger, focus lost inside a map, is not observable in text; the dead end that is observable is a '404 · Andaz' page on a different template without site chrome (E-SITE-17, E-SITE-19).
most_useful_feature: A Dream City project page exists with full localized text and coordinates (E-SITE-08); rental listings in it (T02) were not observable.
missing_information: Rent listings in Dream City with yard and parking, and any price cue that does not rely on red/green, neither of which could be verified.
what_would_change_decision: A text-only rental list with price and updated date that works without the map.
simulated_reaction: «دوو لاپەڕەی ئۆفەر هەیە و یەکێکیان ناونیشانی نییە؛ نازانم کرێ لە کوێ بگەڕێم.» (There are two offers pages and one has no heading; I do not know where to search for rentals.)

initial_understanding: As an owner weighing a sale, «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت» fits his need; the longer description about indicators and offers is a lot of text for a slow reader (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: The valuation page is headed «نرخاندنی ناوخۆیی», internal valuation, and he cannot tell whether it is meant for visitors like him (E-SITE-16).
trust_concern_observed: None observed lowering trust; the homepage is served with lang=ckb, so he is not pushed into another language on arrival (E-SITE-01).
frustration_point: His trigger is an unreadable language; the account pages at the Kurdish path are English ('Welcome back') (E-SITE-12), and the advisor conversation he hoped for (T10) was not observable.
most_useful_feature: The advisor landing «با ئەو شوێنە بدۆزینەوە کە بۆ تۆ گونجاوە.» exists in Kurdish without login (E-SITE-13); its usefulness is unverified.
missing_information: Size, floor, delivery date and fees for Hawler New City; the area page «هەولێری نوێ» carries only the generic site description (E-SITE-23).
what_would_change_decision: A plain-Kurdish valuation entry that states total cost including fees.
simulated_reaction: «دەنووسێت بەهای خانووەکەت، باشە، بەڵام لە ناوەوە دەنووسێت نرخاندنی ناوخۆیی؛ ئەوە بۆ منە یان بۆ خۆیان؟» (It says your property's value, fine, but inside it says internal valuation; is that for me or for them?)
